title: Failed breakouts
summary: A failed breakout moves through a level, then comes back inside. You only know it failed afterwards.
unreliableWhen: Waiting for more confirmation avoids some failures but enters later, at a worse price, and still gets caught by some. Judging after the fact makes failures look obvious.
goodExample: Committing to "real", "fake" or "wait" before seeing more candles, then recording how each call turned out.
badExample: Deciding a breakout was "obviously fake" only after seeing what happened next.

chart.lookFor: Mark the range, find the candle that closed outside it, and note how many candles passed before price was back inside.
